title: CRISPR activation screens identify oncogenic lncRNAs that are susceptible to CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment.
model: MCF-7, lncRNA CRISPRa (SAM), genome-wide and focused libraries
contrast: Palbociclib vs untreated, genome-wide (3 vs 1); focused screen (3 vs 2) as secondary
paper_calls: 685 genes at treatment Wald FDR 0.10 genome-wide (494 sensitizing); 49 in the focused screen; TENM3-AS1, LINC01117, ENSG00000226706 validated
barcs_calls: Genome-wide: 13 genes at FDR 0.10 after control calibration (28.8% of controls at p < 0.05 before), 0 against the control null
named_hits: 0/3 at FDR 0.10 genome-wide (TENM3-AS1 rank 146 among depleted genes by p, FDR 0.60; LINC01117 and ENSG00000226706 lean enriched)
verdict: BARCS does not support the paper's lncRNA hits: with one untreated library, non-targeting guides differ between arms as much as targeted lncRNAs (28.8% at p < 0.05), and after calibration only 13 genes pass FDR 0.10 (11 of them paper calls, all marginal and none against the control null); the focused screen's controls fail outright (87.5%). GEO's sample labels conflict with the paper; the mapping used here was inferred from the data.
